usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.admin.organization.groups.roles.list("group_id", limit: 1, after: "after", order: "asc")
pp result

typeReference.signature: client.admin.organization.groups.roles.list(group_id, limit: nil, after: nil, order: nil) -> Page<Models::AssignedRoleDetails>

fields.name: limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of organization role assignments to return.

fields.name: after
fields.description: Cursor for pagination. Provide the value from the previous response's `next` field to continue listing organization roles.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order for the returned organization roles.

fields.name: resource_type
fields.description: Resource type the role applies to.

fields.name: predefined_role
fields.description: Whether the role is predefined by OpenAI.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the role was last updated.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Identifier of the actor who created the role.

fields.name: created_by_user_obj
fields.description: User details for the actor that created the role, when available.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Arbitrary metadata stored on the role.
